name: 堆叠光谱图 (Stacked Spectra: XRD / 27Al NMR)
when: Multiple 1D spectra (PXRD patterns, 27Al MAS NMR, Raman, FTIR) stacked vertically inside a single shared frame with explicit vertical offsets and right-side or inline sample labels.

required_slots.x: Common or per-series x-axis (2theta in deg ascending for XRD; chemical shift ppm descending for NMR).
required_slots.series: 2..6 numeric intensity columns ordered bottom-to-top (e.g. Support, Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C).

optional_slots.offsets: Explicit per-curve vertical offsets; if raw file already contains pre-stacked offsets (e.g. xrd_stacked.txt), set spec offsets to 0 or re-baseline cleanly.
optional_slots.peak_guides: Short vertical dashed guide lines stopping cleanly near peak tops with wavenumber/ppm/2theta labels (e.g. 59, 52, 30, -1 ppm in 27Al NMR).

data_contract.x_direction: ascending for XRD (3-40 deg); descending for NMR (e.g. [90, -25] ppm)
constraints: Do NOT normalize curves independently unless explicitly required to preserve equal baseline spacing; document any baseline/scale factor in spec.
Check whether input table already includes vertical offsets (xrd_stacked.txt starts at ~0.35, 1.07, 1.64, 2.25).
For 27Al NMR raw Bruker/TXT files without headers, verify column 1 = ppm and column 2 = real spectrum intensity.

notes: Fig2A (XRD): 4 curves (Support #B00F1A, Catalyst-A #6699BA, Catalyst-B #CCA8E3, Catalyst-C #8CCF8C) with equal spacing and right-side sample labels clear of curves.

Fig2C (27Al NMR): compact vertical offset (~0.55 of normalized height) so peaks overlap slightly like reference; short dashed guides at 59, 52, 30, -1 ppm stopping cleanly near peaks instead of spanning full box height.
XRD .asc files in data/raw_xrd/ contain only intensity (4 values/line); 2theta must be reconstructed from *START/*STOP/*STEP.
